prompt: From a low hillside, framed through one arch of the long Victorian brick viaduct at Stockport, which crosses a valley of terraced streets: a commuter train stopped dead mid-span, its carriage lights dying car by car, a few small silhouettes at the windows, sparks spitting from the overhead line. Beyond is the city skyline with tower cranes, whole sectors gone dark, and an orange fireball and a smoke column on the horizon. 85mm. Night in a near-future Britain, photographed like a feature film on 35mm stock: fine grain, inky blacks that stay black, no lens flare, no bloom. 16:9. No writing anywhere in the frame: no number plates, signs, logos or screen text.
